correctness.rationale: The state transitions exactly implement each binary carry and local 11-adjacency change; the zero-shift tail is solved by a convergent geometric carry recursion. The resulting rational generating functions have exact polynomial parts Q1,...,Q7. Direct rational-matrix multiplication establishes the characteristic polynomial and the proper F8−F7 difference. Cayley–Hamilton proves every later increment is divisible by an additional 1/z and hence cannot change a nonnegative probability. The sharpness at a=7 follows from Q6≠Q7. An explicit cylinder approximation proves natural-density existence. The bundled checker verified these exact identities using rational symbolic arithmetic and finite integer tests, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: Two isolated 1 bits are the minimal sparse shift family outside a single run, and fixed two-block shifts lie outside the many-block Gaussian regime of the motivating theory. The result gives a complete exact nonnegative fluctuation law (not a single finite evaluation or bound) for infinitely many shifts and identifies the sharp separation threshold. In particular, the stable nondecrease density 175/256 is an exact Cusick-type statistic, and stabilization of only the nonnegative side despite continuing changes in negative tails is a useful finite-memory structural property.
